title: Key-only identity searches should request FIELD_VALUES with just SEARCH_FIELD_NAME
answers: How should I write a search request that only needs to tell one resource from another by identity?
Why request the title field when validation only compares row.Key.Name?
What's the minimal search request for a self-vs-other-resource uniqueness check?
body: When a search exists only to distinguish 'this resource' from 'another resource' (e.g. title-uniqueness self-match checks, or existence checks like folder-ownership), the filter (Options.Fields) can still match on a semantic field like title, but the requested Fields/ResultFormat should not fetch that field back — only resource.SEARCH_FIELD_NAME is needed, via ResultFormat: resourcepb.ResourceSearchRequest_FIELD_VALUES. The exact-match filter stays on the real field (e.g. SEARCH_FIELD_TITLE) in Options.Fields; only the returned payload is minimized. See pkg/registry/apis/iam/team/validate.go:validateTitleUnique and pkg/services/team/folderownership/validation.go:ValidateNoOwnedFolders for the pattern.
applies: New or modified resourcepb.Search calls in Grafana core whose only use of the result is comparing resource identity (Key.Name), not any other field value.
says: Resource uniqueness checks fetch more fields than necessary
Title validation searches return excessive resource data
Why does unique name validation require full resource information
Identity verification fetches unnecessary fields from search results
Folder ownership checks request more data than needed
search: When a resource search exists solely to distinguish identity (title uniqueness self-match checks, folder-ownership existence validation), the filter Options.Fields can target semantic fields like SEARCH_FIELD_TITLE, but the returned Fields and ResultFormat must request only resource.SEARCH_FIELD_NAME via resourcepb.ResourceSearchRequest_FIELD_VALUES. This minimizes the returned payload to just Key.Name comparisons while keeping the exact-match filter on the actual field. Applies to new or modified resourcepb.Search calls in Grafana core where the result is used only for identity comparison, exemplified in validateTitleUnique (pkg/registry/apis/iam/team/validate.go) and ValidateNoOwnedFolders (pkg/services/team/folderownership/validation.go).
